cards.title: Button Captain on Spoon-Ferry Pier
cards.characterSkill: Build a character from a pretend pocket item, a small wish, and a gentle worry.
cards.useCase: Use this adult-led paper card as a printable character starter for a short fictional harbor story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Fold the card so the pretend coat-pocket flap covers the prompts, then reveal one line at a time: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Kid: Make up a character for the paper harbor world. Start with one safe pretend detail: ____________________.
cards.characterNamePrompt: Give the spoon-ferry helper a made-up name: ____________________.
cards.pocketItemPrompt: Name or draw the tiny paper item tucked in the pretend coat pocket: ____________________.
cards.wantPrompt: Write what the character wants before the lunchbox tide turns: ____________________.
cards.worryPrompt: Write the small worry that makes the choice tricky: ____________________.
cards.actionPrompt: Write one gentle action the character tries on the ferry pier: ____________________.
cards.voicePrompt: Write one sentence in the character's own voice: ____________________.
cards.reviseCharacterPrompt: Change one detail so the character feels more surprising: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: choose the pocket item silently, then fill this line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: A character can start with one paper pocket item and one wish: ____________________.

cards.title: The Acorn Stamp Clerk's Tiny Mix-Up
cards.characterSkill: Show character through a job, a pocket clue, and a helpful choice.
cards.useCase: Use this adult-led paper card as a printable character card for a fictional errand-office scene: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Place the card beside a pencil and call the coat pocket a pretend paper pocket, not real clothing: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Kid: Invent an office character who helps in a made-up acorn avenue. First idea: ____________________.
cards.characterNamePrompt: Give the acorn stamp clerk a made-up name: ____________________.
cards.pocketItemPrompt: Write the pretend paper pocket item that causes a tiny mix-up: ____________________.
cards.wantPrompt: Write what the character wants to fix or finish today: ____________________.
cards.worryPrompt: Write what the character worries might be misunderstood: ____________________.
cards.actionPrompt: Write one careful action the character takes at the errand counter: ____________________.
cards.voicePrompt: Write one polite line the character says: ____________________.
cards.reviseCharacterPrompt: Add one unexpected habit, sound, or motion to the character: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: point to a prompt, then fill just this blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: A tiny mix-up can reveal what a character cares about: ____________________.

cards.title: Map-Room Seed Keeper with a Folded Clue
cards.characterSkill: Connect a fictional role, object, goal, and hesitation into a stronger character.
cards.useCase: Use this adult-led paper card as a printable character-building prompt for a make-believe seed-library map room: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Cut the card apart if desired and keep the pocket clue fictional, with no real addresses or private places: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Kid: Create a map-room character from invented details only. First clue: ____________________.
cards.characterNamePrompt: Give the seed keeper a made-up name: ____________________.
cards.pocketItemPrompt: Write the folded paper clue found in the pretend coat pocket: ____________________.
cards.wantPrompt: Write what the character wants the map to help with: ____________________.
cards.worryPrompt: Write the character's quiet worry about choosing the wrong seed shelf: ____________________.
cards.actionPrompt: Write one thoughtful action the character takes in the map room: ____________________.
cards.voicePrompt: Write one sentence that sounds like this character speaking: ____________________.
cards.reviseCharacterPrompt: Revise the character by changing the clue, the want, or the worry: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: fill one blank and let the adult read the card aloud: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: A good fictional character has a clue, a want, and a worry: ____________________.

cards.title: Rain-Gauge Conductor and the Puddle Ticket
cards.characterSkill: Use a character's object and decision to reveal personality.
cards.useCase: Use this adult-led paper card as a printable character prompt for a fictional rain-gauge railway story: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Present the coat pocket as a drawn paper pocket on the card and keep the railway path imaginary: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Kid: Make a conductor, passenger, or station helper for the pretend railway. Start here: ____________________.
cards.characterNamePrompt: Give the railway character a made-up name: ____________________.
cards.pocketItemPrompt: Write the pretend paper pocket item, such as a puddle ticket or gauge note: ____________________.
cards.wantPrompt: Write what the character wants to understand about the rainy railway: ____________________.
cards.worryPrompt: Write what makes the character pause before acting: ____________________.
cards.actionPrompt: Write one kind or clever action the character takes near the rain gauge: ____________________.
cards.voicePrompt: Write one line the character would say on the platform: ____________________.
cards.reviseCharacterPrompt: Change one trait so the character reacts differently to the rain: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: choose a role and fill this one blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: A pocket item can show how a character solves a problem: ____________________.

cards.title: Moss Message Signal-Sorter
cards.characterSkill: Create a character voice by pairing a strange job with a personal concern.
cards.useCase: Use this adult-led paper card as a printable character card for a fictional moss-message observatory scene: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: Read the prompts aloud and remind writers that all names, places, and pocket items are made up: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Kid: Invent a signal-sorter, moss reader, or signal helper. Begin with one imagined detail: ____________________.
cards.characterNamePrompt: Give the observatory character a made-up name: ____________________.
cards.pocketItemPrompt: Write the pretend paper pocket item that helps read moss messages: ____________________.
cards.wantPrompt: Write what the character hopes to discover from the soft observatory signals: ____________________.
cards.worryPrompt: Write the gentle worry that keeps the character careful: ____________________.
cards.actionPrompt: Write one patient action the character takes while sorting messages: ____________________.
cards.voicePrompt: Write one sentence in a calm character voice: ____________________.
cards.reviseCharacterPrompt: Revise by adding one new quirk, tool, or rule for the character: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: draw the pocket item first, then name it here: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: A character gets stronger when a job, item, and worry fit together: ____________________.
